answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Work waits on the spiral until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the umber of the next round. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Reaching the tide of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
